notes: The form is labelled "FDP Form 6 - Trust Fund Utilization" (the same form and projects as the trust-fund series); the catalog classifies it as a project status report by its printed title.
Dates are printed day-first (e.g. 31/07/2024, 06/11/2024, 11/01/2025, 08/10/2019) and were converted accordingly, consistent with the trust-fund series.
Project names are as printed apart from obvious typos: the source prints "Lapu;apu City Health Center" (Lapulapu) and "Multi-Porpuse" (Multi-Purpose).
Low-resolution scan; all figures were re-read on a 4500px re-render of the PDF.
Project 3 is printed at 100% completion with cost incurred 3,972,087.48 and remark "Completed but final billing not paid yet" (later reports show 4,967,028.65).
Project 3 target completion (11/01/2025) is after the reporting period; transcribed as printed.
No totals are printed, so summary.totalCost and summary.costIncurred are null.
